title: Elon Musk's "Loop" - It's bad, folks
summary: A long, sarcastic critique of Elon Musk's Loop tunnel transit idea and related Boring Company and Hyperloop claims. It leans on transit-planning arguments about capacity and throughput.
why: HN uses it as the go-to rebuttal when Musk's transportation proposals come up, though it is mostly cited by skeptics.

quote.text: he gives some realistic criticism if you can get past the jokes
